subject: terrain
title: The editor's draw tools: sculpt, splat, paint, path
note: First captures of the editor's Draw bar. A drag with the sculpt brush raises a ridge on a terrain (three strokes, each one terrain_edit, journaled as window:owner and undone with Ctrl+Z); the splat brush paints a ground layer along it; the paint brush colours a barrel's vertices (model_paint: paint colours vertices, so a stroke that reaches none is refused); the path tool redraws a rail's sweep path from a sketched arc (model_path). Every stroke is data in the recipe's file.
